header.headline: Modern software for digital transformation.
header.subline: AI-native solutions for complex enterprise requirements.

hero.canvasLabel: The utxo AG wordmark as a solid body that breaks into cubes when touched

services.name: Software Development
services.short: Custom software, AI-assisted where needed, from concept to production.
services.body: We develop custom software for your processes, AI-assisted on request, from concept to production. A dedicated team is responsible for architecture, development and ongoing enhancement.
services.mockupLabel: Animated example sequence: from workflow to web application, mobile app and integrations through to release.

services.name: Agent Factories and AI Infrastructure
services.short: The foundation on which your organization develops and operates agents at scale.
services.body: We develop the platform your organization uses to produce, test and operate AI agents at scale. Hosting tailored to your requirements: Germany, EU or on-premises.
services.mockupLabel: Animated example: AI agents are produced at scale on shared infrastructure and go into operation.

services.name: Managed Agents
services.short: AI agents that we develop, host and monitor for you.
services.body: We develop, host and monitor your AI agents. You can see at any time what is running, what is done and where your approval is needed.
services.mockupLabel: Animated example: operations console with running AI agents and one task waiting for your approval.

services.name: Agentic CoWorker
services.short: AI CoWorkers that join your team like colleagues.
services.body: AI CoWorkers join your team like colleagues. They take on tasks in the channel your team already uses, ask when something is unclear and deliver results for review.
services.mockupLabel: Animated example: an AI CoWorker works in the team channel, asks questions and delivers results for review.

services.name: AI Automation
services.short: Recurring processes that run on their own in your systems.
services.body: Recurring processes run on their own in your existing systems, from intake to posting. Exceptions go to your team for approval.
services.mockupLabel: Animated example: cases pass through five stations automatically; one exception waits for your approval.

services.name: AI Adoption and Consulting
services.short: From selecting the right use cases to rollout in your teams.
services.body: Together with you, we identify the use cases with the greatest benefit and bring them into production step by step. Some are in production within a few weeks, others take months. We support the rollout in your teams.
services.mockupLabel: Animated example: use cases are selected by benefit and effort and brought into production.

lead.name: Serviceplan Group
